rabbi-yoshiya.name: Rabbi Yoshiya
rabbi-yoshiya.bio: Tanna of the school of Rabbi Yishmael, often cited in baraitot disputing the exposition of verses with Rabbi Yonatan.
rabbi-yoshiya.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a sand-coloured wool mantle, one hand resting on an open scroll as if weighing the wording of a verse; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
